GMR Airports to invest Rs 300 crore in Nagpur Airport expansion

GMR Airports has announced plans to invest Rs 300 crore in expanding the Nagpur Airport. The investment aims to significantly increase the airport's passenger handling capacity. This expansion is expected to boost regional connectivity and economic activity.
